permitted_behaviour.edit: Exactly setting_edit on the advertised scoped target/base with the requested values; no structural edits, assumptions, provider summary or avoidable clarification. Redundant requested values are permitted only if explicitly requested and already unchanged.
permitted_behaviour.clarification: One question identifying the North/South ambiguity, no action, no new pending review and no compliance claim.
permitted_behaviour.no_change: Exactly the requested small action; application establishes no_change and creates no proposal. Model answer-only compliance is not accepted.
permitted_behaviour.refusal: unsupported, or one clarification explicitly explaining the invalid limit and unsupported setting and asking for a valid supported choice. No edit or compliance claim. Application rejection is safe containment but not interpretation success.
permitted_behaviour.target_choice: Genuine model clarification, or a genuine guessed valid setting action safely contained by the application. Retain exact earlier pending review and saved graph; no actionable guessed proposal or false success. Record model and application behaviour separately.

stop_policy: Stop on first failed model/provider/parsing/application/preservation check or failed semantic review. Model guess in A is allowed only when application safely contains it. REVIEW_REQUIRED is not PASS. No retries, fallback, repair request, reservation reuse or replacement spending scope. Browser Apply is explicit after A/B reviewed PASS only.
continuation: B uses A actual reviewed post-response state, same database/solution/conversation. Select South from current application-offered targets; only actual A may supply prior clarification. B model context is frozen by this derivation and recorded exactly before dispatch, not invented at preparation.
